plan.notes: Official Delaware State University 2025-2026 Undergraduate Catalog, 'B.S. DEGREE IN BIOLOGICAL SCIENCES - GENERAL BIOLOGY' (concentration required; this is the General Biology concentration). CREDIT HONESTY: the catalog header prints 'Total Credits: 120', but every published semester total matches its itemized courses exactly and the itemized semesters sum to 16+14+16+15+16+17+15+12 = 121. Recorded at the itemized 121 with this discrepancy disclosed (the catalog's own General Note says Biological Sciences students 'usually complete between 121-123 hours'). BIOL-321 recorded at 3 cr as printed in the plan ('Biostatics 3'); the major-courses table prints 'Biostatistics 4' - disclosed. BIOL-301/BIOL-451 Capstone I slot recorded at 2 cr as printed in the plan; the major-courses table prints BIOL-451 as 1 cr - disclosed. Biology Elective slots (4 cr each): any course from the General Biology elective list (BIOL-305, 307, 315, 316, 322, 407, 411, 420, 422, 464; minimum 18 cr of biology electives required per catalog). CHEM-403 Biochemistry OR BIOL-422 Biochemical Mechanisms choice slot. Independent research project/internship required before BIOL-499 per catalog. C-or-better required in all biology and CAST courses.
